title: A sprint's start warns of an item check that already passes before the work
goal: Retro SP-ytfb4dc5: ST-f4ra5s7y's grep check passed vacuously (git rejected a ':!_tools' pathspec with exit 128, empty stdout counted as a pass). Before a sprint starts (backlog.py start, or a planning check the kb-sprint plan step runs), each committed item's checks run once and a check that already exits 0 before any work commit is named as a warning (it proves nothing), unless the item says why (a check that pins behaviour that must stay). A planted test: an item whose check passes on the base is warned of, one whose check fails is not.
